interpretation: All200 performance points compare five internal arms with two external objectives over native/original coordinates and h1–h10; all favor the internal arm with negative unadjusted paired intervals. They are correlated development comparisons, not200 independent confirmations.
The200 persistence-difference points are identical cross-method control scores with null intervals; these check measurement consistency rather than a performance benefit.
Both external objectives are worse than persistence at native and original2x2 h5/h10. This limitation remains explicitly reported; no outcome is omitted or method/epoch reselected.

The study is a posthoc development comparison of an adapted official DINO-WM implementation. Pooled tokens, command interface, normalization, model capacity and optimization recipe differ from the official planning benchmark; no SOTA/generalization/causal inference follows.
